notes:
BUILD 30
- Reloads: your hands now do the work. The left hand closes around the magazine to pull it and seat the new one, hooks the charging handle to rack it, and the trigger finger comes off the trigger while you reload. Shotguns get the same treatment while feeding shells.
- Faster: things too small or too far to cast a shadow you could see no longer get drawn into the shadow maps (about 40% fewer shadow draws at busy monuments), and objects smaller than a pixel or two are skipped.
